race.description: Moonee Beach Hotel Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: VERMEER (2) drops in trip and grade after he did little when a month between runs for a poor eighth over 2150m at Ipswich in BM65 class. Winkers come off and will appreciate a firmer surface. Deserves another chance. RELEASETHEWOLVES (9) win record hardly excites but looks well placed today with the 4kg claimer aboard and the tongue-tie going on. Strong late when fourth over 1512m at Port Macquarie on the heavy (8) surface. Ready for this stronger race. Each way. DIPIERDOMENICO (5) gave away a considerable start with a plugging fifth over 2000m at Quirindi. Senior rider hops back aboard and can take a hand in the finish. VENOM WOLF (3) going well this prep and drops sharply in trip and grade here. Struggled to close off when fourth in the Ken Howard over 2000m at this track. Can return to form.
